## SOC EF (delta SOC) for US

We are using the RF model (5-y moving average) to estimate SOC changes from crop C input



```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
source("setup.R")
load("Output/Model_5.RData") # ML model from 5-y moving average.
#model <-read_rds("Models/SiteData_5y_20250721.rds")


SiteData <- read_csv(us_outputs("0.4_US_Cinput.csv")) %>%
  mutate(TEXT = case_when(
    Texture == "Fine"      ~ 3,
    Texture == "Medium"    ~ 2,
    Texture == "Coarse"    ~ 1,
    TRUE                   ~NA_integer_
  ))

#helper for weighted means that gracefully handles all-NA cases
w_mean <- function(x, w) {
  if (all(is.na(x))) return(NA_real_)
  weighted.mean(x, w, na.rm = TRUE)
}  

Area <- SiteData %>%
        group_by(STATE)%>% 
        summarise(Area = sum(AREA)/3) %>%
        mutate(Area_Perc = Area/sum(Area)*100)

```

## SOC change prediction, Not CROP Specific!

County level first and aggregate to state level

```{r not crop specific}

SiteData_Agg <- SiteData %>%
  mutate(AREA = AREA * Frac/100) %>%
  group_by(STATE, COUNTY, TEXT) %>%
  summarise(
    Cinput = sum(Cinput * AREA) / sum(AREA),
    total_area = sum(AREA),
    MAT = first(MAT),
    MAP = first(MAP),
    MPE = first(MPE),
    CARB30 = first(CARB30),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  na.omit()
    
#County level data
SiteData_Agg$SOC_predict <- predict(rf_model, newdata = SiteData_Agg)



# Aggregated to state level
#obtain weighted values and simple average
SiteData_State <- SiteData_Agg %>% 
  group_by(STATE) %>% 
  summarise(
    across(
      c(Cinput, MAT, MAP, MPE, CARB30, SOC_predict),
      list(avg  = ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
           wavg = ~w_mean(.x, total_area)),
      .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"                              # remove grouping (optional)
  )%>% 
  select(STATE, Cinput_wavg, MAT_wavg, MAP_wavg, MPE_wavg, CARB30_wavg,SOC_predict_wavg)
  
SiteData_State <- SiteData_State %>%
  left_join(Area, by = "STATE")

summary(SiteData_State) # SOC_predict_wavg, median 0.13371, mean 0.17385, min 0.04158 t/ha
#write.csv(SiteData_State, "Output/1. SOC_Cinput_EF_US_Agg.csv", row.names = FALSE)


```




## SOC change prediction

county level first and aggregate to state level

```{r}
#County level data
SiteData$SOC_predict <- predict(rf_model, newdata = SiteData)

#CAP deltaSOC to Cinput
SiteData <- SiteData %>%
  mutate(SOC_predict = ifelse(SOC_predict > Cinput, Cinput, SOC_predict))

#write.csv(SiteData, "Output/1. SOC_Cinput_EF_US_county.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Aggregated to state level
#obtain weighted values and simple average
SiteData_State <- SiteData %>% 
  filter(Cinput > 0) %>%
  mutate(area_w = AREA * Frac / 100) %>%          # weight column once
  group_by(STATE, CROP, CLASS, UTIL_PRACTICE_DESC) %>% 
  summarise(
    across(
      c(Cinput, MAT, MAP, MPE, CARB30, SOC_predict),
      list(avg  = ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
           wavg = ~w_mean(.x, area_w)),
      .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"                              # remove grouping (optional)
  )%>% 
  select(STATE, CROP, CLASS, UTIL_PRACTICE_DESC, Cinput_wavg, MAT_wavg, MAP_wavg, MPE_wavg, CARB30_wavg,SOC_predict_wavg)

summary(SiteData_State) # SOC_predict_wavg, median 0.064014, mean 0.092868, min -0.111136t/ha
#write.csv(SiteData_State, "Output/1. SOC_Cinput_EF_US_GrainSplit.csv", row.names = FALSE)

#obtain weighted values and simple average, Silage and grain aggregagted
SiteData_State <- SiteData %>% 
  mutate(area_w = AREA * Frac / 100) %>%          # weight column once
  group_by(STATE, CROP, CLASS) %>% 
  summarise(
    across(
      c(Cinput, MAT, MAP, MPE, CARB30, SOC_predict),
      list(avg  = ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
           wavg = ~w_mean(.x, area_w)),
      .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"                              # remove grouping (optional)
  ) %>%
  select(STATE, CROP, CLASS, Cinput_wavg, MAT_wavg, MAP_wavg, MPE_wavg, CARB30_wavg,SOC_predict_wavg)

summary(SiteData_State) # SOC_predict_wavg, median 0.064014, mean 0.092966, min -0.111136 t/ha
#write.csv(SiteData_State, "Output/1. SOC_Cinput_EF_US_GrainAgg.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```


## QC check. if I put dummy 0 for Cinput, would delta SOC go to 0?

```{r}
SiteData_QC <- SiteData %>% 
  mutate(Cinput  = 0.01)

SiteData_QC$SOC_predict <- predict(rf_model, newdata = SiteData_QC)
  





```
